operation.description: Inference sessions, not browser devices. Shared members see only their own human-key activity; workspace admins/owners see workspace-wide activity. A personal workspace that is not yours, and an unknown workspace, are 404. A SHARED workspace you do not belong to is 403, even for a Platform Admin or Auditor (resources.rs detail_access), so platform authority alone never grants detail access. Inside a workspace you belong to, a session that is not visible to you is 404, and so is a session label that is not a valid client session id. Counts and money strings preserve unknown usage as null. Dates are half-open UTC [start_date,end_date), default last 30 days and tomorrow end; at most 93 days. The detail route rejects paging and session_id query fields.

parameters.description: Exclusive UTC end date (YYYY-MM-DD), at most tomorrow; default tomorrow.

parameters.description: Exact public model name: 1 to 200 characters (as maxLength counts; #405), no control characters (LogQuery::filters, logs.rs:114-120).

parameters.description: Comma-separated finish reasons: stop, length, tool_calls, content_filter, error, cancelled, unknown.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque: send only a next_cursor returned by a previous page of the same filters. Today it is '<last-activity microseconds since the epoch>_<workspace uuid>_<hex of the UTF-8 session id>'. The handler (logs.rs session_cursor) splits at the first two underscores, parses the first part as a signed 64-bit integer (a leading '+' is accepted) that must be a representable timestamp, parses the second with uuid::Uuid::parse_str (which also accepts the simple, braced and URN spellings), and requires an even-length hex third part of at most 1024 hex characters that decodes to a valid session id; anything else is 400. The schema pattern admits only the form the gateway emits (hyphenated uuid, no '+', at most 19 digits) and cannot check the 64-bit or timestamp range or the decoded session id.
